conclusion.en: The coop_3 group shows a significantly lower medication withdrawal rate compared to the rest of the ATS (89.01% vs 99.92%), with very high hospital readmission rates in the associated municipalities (up to 50% in Roverbella). The intervention should focus on municipalities with lower withdrawal rates (e.g. Izano, Fiesco, Camisano) and patients with more risk drivers, with an emphasis on timely follow-up and medication withdrawal support.
